scope: Behavioral diagnostics, not a scored quality claim. Synthetic cases are not historical facts.
comparison: Same revision, model, materials, budgets and entrypoint; toggle FINANCE_RESEARCH_REASONING only. Each case uses a new isolated conversation or an isolated copy of the same original-turn snapshot. Keep every failed run. These are development cases, not held-out cases. A refusal is not a correct answer; prompt delivery and fixture arithmetic tests do not establish behavioral success.
